meta.source: The Edgework identity agreed with Alex on the Claude Design canvas (board 'D · Edgework' and the mark library), as built in the private Owl Farm newsroom (src/edgework.css, src/lib/marks.js). Version 1 adds the public site's night ground and spacing, motion and layout tokens.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The desk the sheets sit on. Always with the paper scan (assets/marks/paper-45.jpg) laid over it; the flat colour is only the fallback while the scan loads.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: A typed sheet, index card or manuscript page sitting on the paper. Every sheet casts shadow-sheet.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Typewriter text, Anton headlines and 2px rules on paper and sheet. Also the night ground.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on paper and sheet: decks, excerpts, dates (7.9:1 on paper).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary notes on paper and sheet only: file numbers, read times (4.9:1 on paper).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules on sheets, like the ruled lines of a pad. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The visible edge of a control on paper (3.2:1). Field underlines use ink.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Red pen. Margin scrawl, the one active nav item, the 'HEY RUBE.' stamp tint and the primary button outline. On paper or sheet (4.9:1). Never a large fill except the Routine card.

tokens.name: red-night
tokens.usage: Red pen on the night ground (6.1:1). Use it instead of red whenever the ground is night.

tokens.name: coffee
tokens.usage: Only inside the stain marks. Never set text in it.

tokens.name: manila
tokens.usage: The folder behind a FileCard and its tab. Only on folders.

tokens.name: manila-ink
tokens.usage: Label text on a manila folder tab (7.6:1 on manila).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The 4am ground: the masthead, the footer and the full-bleed Hey Rube band. One night band per page besides the frame.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night (16.4:1).

tokens.name: on-night-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night (9.4:1).

styles.name: shout-xl
styles.usage: The one hero headline per page, uppercase, with the letterpress mask. 64px on phones.

styles.name: shout
styles.usage: Section titles, uppercase, letterpress mask. 44px on phones.

styles.name: shout-sm
styles.usage: Essay titles on file cards and dispatch headlines in lists. 28px on phones.

styles.name: type-lg
styles.sample: The funnel hasn't sped up. It has moved inside the model.
styles.usage: A Position on its index card and the pull line of a dispatch. Every word jitters (see README). 22px on phones.

styles.name: type
styles.sample: Six minutes into Omaha Beach, the plan was dead.
styles.usage: Long reading: dispatch bodies and essay excerpts. Max 68 characters a line. 17px on phones.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Navigation, file numbers, dates, buttons, filters. Nothing smaller.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Thirty things I think, and the essays that argue them.
styles.usage: Plain interface copy: intros, About text, footer lines.

styles.name: scrawl
styles.usage: Red-pen margin note, rotated 3–7°. One per card or section at most. 16px on phones.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between cards on the wall.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything. Paper has square corners.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Every sheet and card resting on the paper.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: A card being picked up (hover) or an opened dossier.

tokens.name: shadow-strip
tokens.usage: Cut paper strips and tape-held scraps on the night ground.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Paper moving: cards lifting, sheets sliding out.

tokens.name: ease-drop
tokens.usage: A card or strip landing on the desk. The only easing allowed to overshoot.

tokens.name: duration-key
tokens.usage: Time per character when a headline types itself on.

tokens.name: duration-lift
tokens.usage: A card lifting or settling on hover.

tokens.name: duration-slide
tokens.usage: A manuscript sliding out of its folder; a dossier opening.

tokens.name: duration-blink
tokens.usage: The typewriter cursor blink (steps(1)).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on paper and sheet. Use red-night on the night ground.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the element and its focus ring.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Below this: phone sizes, one column, no rotation over 3°.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Below this: two-column wall.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Three-column wall and the full desk.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest the desk runs.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of typewriter reading text.

tokens.name: masthead-height
tokens.usage: The night masthead bar.

tokens.name: ratio-card
tokens.usage: Index card (Position) on desktop. On phones it grows to fit.

tokens.name: ratio-post
tokens.usage: Social card export (1080 × 1350).

tokens.name: ratio-reel
tokens.usage: Routine reel (1080 × 1920).

tokens.name: z-mark
tokens.usage: Stains sit above the sheet but below its text.

tokens.name: z-text
tokens.usage: Text on a sheet.

tokens.name: z-tape
tokens.usage: Tape sits over text and edges.

tokens.name: z-masthead
tokens.usage: Sticky masthead.

tokens.name: z-dossier
tokens.usage: An opened Position dossier and its backdrop.
